# Intimate

> Verified directory for legal adult services in the Netherlands. Every profile
> is identity-verified before going live. Available in Dutch, English and German.

Intimate lists independent professionals and agencies across Dutch cities.
Categories: private visit (incall), escort (outcall), erotic massage, virtual
sex, BDSM. Profiles show verified status, services, rates and live online
presence.
